paragraphs.text: Kamigawa: A Visual Novel is a visual novel , published on February 11, 2022, in accompaniment with the Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty set.
Meet Imperial samurai Touma , Rei from the Hisaku Uprisers and Asuga of the Order of Hanami . Visit the nezumi Itachi in his ramen bar, and track mysterious moonfolk in Towashi .
Investigate a merge gate in Sokenzanshi and the busy streets and establishments of Towashi . No one knows where you may end up next.
Your choices influence not only your companions but also your bonded kami. Diplomacy or intimidation, sympathy or hostility – it’s all up to you.

As you travel through Kamigawa, you may bump into some familiar faces. Characters based on the band Kero Kero Bonito , content creators Sweet Anita , Shurjoka , The Asian Avenger , and ChocolateKieran are all in the game for you to find.

Several faction names have been changed or may have retained development names from the main set. The Order of Jukai is instead called "Order of Hanami", the Saiba Futurists are known as "Kindai Futurists", and the Asari Uprisers are instead known as the "Hisaku Uprisers". Kyodai is also inexplicably addressed with male pronouns.
